verdict.rationale: Render's CLI documents viewing logs, including logs for multiple resources at once, and the platform claims observability features that can stream telemetry to external tools. That makes log viewing a first-party capability. However, the evidence never says build, deploy, and runtime logs are unified in one view, and the docs note the Dashboard is limited to one resource at a time. missing for 10: explicit documentation that build, deploy, and runtime logs appear together in one place; dashboard-level unified log view; independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can view all my build, deploy, and runtime logs in one place

citations.quote: Unlike in the Render Dashboard, you can view logs for multiple resources at once.
See critical metrics for all of your Render infrastructure from day zero, and stream telemetry to external tools.
